# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.2 Worker 2: Colonization 3.0 Core — Cold-Start Cure, Golden Loop, Chartered Companies & Late-Game Autonomy (oe_col3_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v122_col3_core.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# EU5 1.4.9 cabinet_actions: potential/allow execute in bare country scope; AI scoring uses ai_will_do (cabinet_actions
# does not parse ai_prerequisite in EU5 1.4.9 — verified against vanilla cabinet_actions/readme.txt).

# 1. Audit Chartered Monopoly & Dividends (DIP)
oe_col3_cab_charter_monopoly = {
	ability = dip
	helps_with = "charter|location"
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
		has_ports = yes
		OR = {
			has_colonial_charters = yes
			is_colonial_overlord = yes
			has_law = oe_col3_chartered_company_law
			any_owned_location = {
				OR = {
					continent = continent:america
					sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
					sub_continent = sub_continent:south_east_asia
				}
			}
		}
	}

	allow = {
		OR = {
			has_law = oe_col3_chartered_company_law
			has_colonial_charters = yes
			any_owned_location = { is_overseas_for_owner = yes }
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = province
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_col3_cab_monopoly_select_province"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_col3_cab_monopoly_no_provinces"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			any_location_in_province = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:actor
				controller ?= scope:actor
				OR = {
					is_coastal = yes
					is_market_center = yes
				}
			}
		}
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}

	country_modifier = {
		trade_income = 0.08
		global_merchant_capacity_modifier = 0.12
		colonial_maintenance_efficiency = 0.10
	}

	location_modifier = {
		local_trade_center_power = 0.15
		local_merchant_capacity = 1.0
		local_monthly_prosperity = 0.002
	}

	map_marker = { show_for_owner = yes }

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:actor = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						has_ports = yes
						OR = {
							has_colonial_charters = yes
							any_owned_location = { is_overseas_for_owner = yes }
						}
					}
				}
				value = 12
			}
		}
	}
}

# 2. Escort Silver & Spice Convoys (MIL)
# Soft-links with v12.5 oe_nav2_letters_of_marque_active & counters overseas piracy drag.
oe_col3_cab_convoy_escort = {
	ability = mil
	helps_with = "location"
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
		has_ports = yes
		OR = {
			has_colonial_charters = yes
			is_colonial_overlord = yes
			has_law = oe_col3_chartered_company_law
			any_owned_location = {
				OR = {
					continent = continent:america
					sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
					sub_continent = sub_continent:south_east_asia
				}
			}
		}
	}

	allow = {
		has_ports = yes
		OR = {
			any_owned_location = { is_overseas_for_owner = yes }
			has_colonial_charters = yes
			any_subject = { is_colonial_subject = yes }
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = province
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_col3_cab_escort_select_province"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_col3_cab_escort_no_provinces"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			any_location_in_province = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:actor
				controller ?= scope:actor
				is_coastal = yes
			}
		}
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}

	on_activate = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_col3_convoy_escort_shield_mod
				years = 3
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}

	country_modifier = {
		trade_sea_efficiency = 0.10
		navy_light_ship_power = 0.10
		navy_light_ship_maintenance_cost_modifier = -0.10
	}

	location_modifier = {
		local_maritime_presence = 0.25
		local_unrest = -0.03
	}

	map_marker = { show_for_owner = yes }

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:actor = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						has_ports = yes
						OR = {
							any_owned_location = { is_overseas_for_owner = yes }
							any_subject = { is_colonial_subject = yes }
						}
					}
				}
				value = 10
			}
		}
	}
}
